subject: cell size in ggplot2 figures and coord_equal

messages.author: b935d451772c58c2
messages.subject: cell size in ggplot2 figures and coord_equal
parts:
Dear all, 

I am using ggplot2 to make waffle plots that show the ratios of different amino acid residues at every position. There are 37 amino acid residue positions; for each position, there could be 1 to 4 different residues present in the population. I would like use waffle plots to show their ratios at each position. I have attached a sample input file. 

Here are my scripts to make the waffle plots, df is the input file I attached:
col4=c('#E66101','#FDB863','#B2ABD2','#5E3C99')
dflist=list()
for (i in 1:37){
ndeep=length(which(df$position==i))
dflist[[i]]=df[df$position==i,2:3] 
waffle=expand.grid(y=1:ndeep,x=seq_len(ceiling(sum(dflist[[i]]$freq)/ndeep)))
residuevec=rep(dflist[[i]]$residue,dflist[[i]]$freq)
waffle$residue=c(as.vector(residuevec),rep(NA,nrow(waffle)-length(residuevec)))
png(paste('plot',i,'.png',sep=''))
print(ggplot(waffle, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = residue)) + geom_tile(color = "white") + scale_fill_manual("residue",values = col4) + coord_equal() + theme(panel.grid.minor=element_blank(), panel.grid.major=element_blank()) + theme(axis.ticks=element_blank()) + theme(axis.text.x=element_blank(), axis.text.y=element_blank()) + theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(), axis.title.y=element_blank()))
dev.off()
}

I noticed that for positions with 1 residue, the cells were very small. Also, positions with 2 residues had smaller cells on the waffle plots compared to positions with 3 or 4 residues. I have attached some example output figures. 

So my questions are:
1. How can I make the cell size equal and all cells square? I think coord_equal() is not enough for doing so, and I am also curious why the cell sizes turned out different. 

2. Is there a way to assign different colors to every amino acid residue, and incorporate that in the for loop? 

Many thanks for any help you may give me,
Zhao
